Trainer...
I... want to win even more.

text_block_list.text:
Win a lot of races,
and become the true "lead role" one day!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes! An even bigger stage...
I'll definitely stand on it!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It's not just about winning; it's about continuing to win...
It really is tough.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Still... after crossing the finish line and standing in the center of the winner's circle...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I felt like even the cheers in the arena
were directed at me today..."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...I thought... that I could do it.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: That I could become a "protagonist" too.
choice_data_list: That's the spirit! I've got high hopes for you!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes! All right, I'm going to win the next race too~!
